name: Onna Kyoushi x Choukyoushi ~Houkago no Ura Jugyou~
original_name: 女教師×調教師～放課後の裏授業～
source:
The protagonist of this story is a very unremarkable, normal student, even in class. One day he drops his mobile phone by accident, and by that coincidence he ends up being drawn in by the evil powers of his teacher, Minami Akira. Following that... she targets a girl who is the same class as our hero, making two victims. The days of Minami's assault and training have begun... !

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033332.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这个故事的主人公是一个非常不起眼的普通学生，即使在课堂上也是如此。有一天，他不小心掉落了手机，机缘巧合之下，他被老师南明的邪恶力量所吸引。接下来……她以与我们的英雄同级的女孩为目标，造成了两名受害者。小南的突击训练日子开始了……！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033332.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
